title: orders.job-ready-for-delivery.v1
description: The ready-for-delivery gate opened on a garment. It is the gate OPENING and not a routine recomputation: the gate is re-evaluated on every custody event and can demote a garment as readily as promote one, so this event is raised only on the transition from not-ready to ready. There is no not-ready event, and none is listed in module-ownership section 5.5 either — a consumer that wants the current verdict re-reads it. There is no blocks list, because the gate opening means no predicate blocked and the list would always be empty; the reason codes that keep a garment back reach a screen through IOrderSnapshotQuery. And there is no actor, on principle rather than by omission: the gate is the system and not a person (INV-JOB-07), and docs/prd/raci.md row 16 says no role, however senior, declares a garment ready.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the verdict was applied to the garment, in UTC. Not the instant the verdict was reached — that is evaluatedAt.

aggregateId.description: The garment job, ordered behind its orders.garment-job-created.v1.

organisationId.description: The organisation the garment belongs to.

branchId.description: The branch holding it for collection.

orderId.description: The order the garment belongs to.

garmentJobNumber.description: The human reference, so a rack tag can be named.

dueDate.description: The garment's promised date, branch-local. The delivery queue is ordered by the promise, which is why it travels on the event that puts a garment onto it.

evaluatedAt.description: When the gate gathered the facts it judged on, in UTC — earlier than or equal to occurredAt, and not the same thing. CI-03 in docs/architecture/invariants.md requires that a ready state never outlives the facts it was computed from, and the domain refuses a verdict older than the one a garment already carries; a consumer needs this instant to make the same comparison rather than trusting arrival order.

boundWithGarmentJobIds.description: The rest of the deliver_together parcel this verdict was reached inside, in job-number order. Empty for a garment bound to nothing and empty where the branch policy permits partial delivery. It is the parcel AS THE GATE SAW IT at evaluatedAt and never durable membership: SQ-07, SQ-08 and SQ-09 in state-transitions.md section 10 are all proposed and unsettled, and SQ-09's interim position is precisely that the queue can show a garment as ready which cannot be handed over until its partner returns. The handover check belongs at the door, against IOrderSnapshotQuery, not in a stored copy of this array.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
